title: No more doom scrolling or Instagram Stories? A Meta trial loss could end the social media we know
summary: A recent trial involving Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, has raised concerns about the future of social media as we know it. Analysts draw parallels between this case and the significant lawsuits against Big Tobacco in the 1990s, suggesting that the outcome could have far-reaching implications for the industry. The potential loss for Meta may lead to a transformation in how social media platforms operate, particularly regarding user engagement and content consumption habits.
